item.title: US federal agencies miss GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules; comment period runs to Aug. 21.
BlackRock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, Goldman Sachs and SoFi endorse the Senate CLARITY Act market structure bill.
CME sues CFTC and its chairman after regulator approved Coinbase to list onchain perpetual futures contracts.
Senate CLARITY Act passage odds fall to 30% as ethics provisions stall bipartisan agreement two weeks before recess.
Morgan Stanley wins preliminary OCC approval for a digital-asset trust bank to offer crypto custody, staking, and lending.
Sony Bank receives conditional OCC approval to form Connectia Trust, a $40M U.S. dollar stablecoin trust bank.
BlackRock reportedly in talks to acquire a 10% stake in Circle ahead of its planned IPO.
JPMorgan moves to allow crypto as loan collateral following enactment of the GENIUS Act stablecoin framework.
Circle freezes $230 million in USDC after stolen funds cross its bridge, prompting debate over stablecoin controls.
Three DeFi protocols lose $35 million in coordinated cross-chain bridge attacks within a six-hour window on July 23.
US and UK regulators call for aligned standards on stablecoin collateral eligibility and tokenized-asset settlement.
SEC plans to propose first crypto rule in July to create temporary registration exemptions and fundraising safe harbors.
FCA finalizes UK crypto asset rules; firms must meet full compliance obligations by a 2027 access deadline.
Australia's Travel Rule took effect July 1, requiring exchanges to verify identity on all transfers regardless of amount.
BitMEX will permanently close in September as declining retail volumes and compliance costs erode mid-tier exchange viability.
